transcription.refined_text: The patient has been complaining of bilateral knee pain for five years. Two years ago, the pain increased, and a plain x-ray was performed, showing advanced grade 4 osteoarthritis. Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs were given for approximately one month along with muscle relaxants, resulting in mild improvement. She is currently undergoing physiotherapy exercises and will be reassessed after two weeks.
